mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in FEDFUNDS below 2% signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS ≥2% or Rank IC <0.05 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly UNRATE crossing above 5.5% triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to heightened labor market uncertainty and reduced investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX returns positive despite UNRATE >5.5% in 1 month or t-test p>0.05 showing no significant negative effect.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent monthly declines in FEDFUNDS below 2% and quarterly GDPC1 growth above 3% signal dual accommodative policy and robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Interaction effect between FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 is not statistically significant (p>0.05) or 60d returns are not positive in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a monthly surge in HOUST above 1050 units predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as excess demand pressures prices upward.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, returns are negative despite HOUST >1050 or Rank IC <0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in RSAFS above 400k units signals robust demand, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as excess demand supports price appreciation.
failure_condition: RSAFS increases but returns are negative or p-value >0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: An INDPRO monthly surge above 112.0 triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to excess supply pressuring prices down in a tight labor market.
failure_condition: INDPRO >112 but returns positive or p>0.05 in t-test.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly convergence of UNRATE below 5% and HOUST above 1000 units signals labor market recovery and demand growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE and HOUST don't move together or interaction effect not significant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a tightening monetary cycle regime, a monthly FEDFUNDS rise above 2.0% predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate higher rates and adjust portfolios.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS >2% in tightening cycle but returns positive or p>0.05 in t-test.
